title: Combine several weak strategies into one prop account (portfolio of strategies)
why: The search scores single strategies only. Several small, uncorrelated edges (different markets/times) traded together in one account can pass where each alone fails. Build a stage that combines the best validated strategies (e.g. 2-4, low correlation of daily P&L) and scores the combination in the prop simulator and the 5-account farm.
evidence: prop search: individual strategies mostly negative EV; NQ/GC/CL daily P&L are largely independent
note: Granted 2026-10-21 (prop_search.py, portfolio stage): after each search run job 1 combines 2-4 strategies into ONE account. Members = the 16 best stage-A strategies (near-duplicates dropped), combinations need pairwise daily-P&L correlation <= 0.3 on 2014-21, one unit = w_i micros of each member (equal risk per member, contracts per unit counted against the plan limits, worst day = every member hits its stop). Members, weights, plan and sizing are chosen on 2014-21 only; the top 5 are validated once on 2022-23 (EV per eval + 5-account farm) and stored in knowledge/prop_search/portfolios.csv; the best 3 appear under PORTFOLIOS in /search. Run alone: python prop_search.py --portfolio (PORTFOLIO_MINUTES, default 10; 0 disables). Combinations do not take the locked exam yet.

title: Correct the prop search for luck (multiple-testing control)
why: With hundreds of thousands of tries, some strategies pass 2022-23 by luck. Track the number of trials per market and require validated EV to beat what random strategies achieve at the same trial count (e.g. compare against the best EV of shuffled-entry placebos, or a deflated threshold). Use it for the leaderboard and the market focus.
evidence: 235k-strategy grid, validation set reused for every candidate | Volta asked for the same itself (#7).
note: Granted 2026-10-21 (prop_search.py): every validated candidate gets 2 no-edge placebos on its own 2022-23 days with the same stop/target/plan/sizing (one random entry minute, one coin-flip side), stored in knowledge/prop_search/null_<job>.csv. Per market the LUCK BAR = the 2022-23 EV that the best of K no-edge strategies reaches with 95% probability (K = that market's validated tries; quantile conf^(1/K) of the placebo pool, normal tail beyond it; needs 30 placebos). Leaderboard ranks by EV above the bar and tags 'BEATS LUCK' / 'luck-level'; mutation parents and the 2 nightly exam slots go only to luck-beaters once a bar exists; market focus counts luck-beaters instead of EV>0 survivors once all markets have a bar. Report line 'LUCK BAR' in the prop search status (Discord /search).

title: Market focus: weight locked-exam passes far above 2022-23 survivors
why: preferences() shifts focus on 2022-23 survival rates, which include lucky passes. Once exams exist, a market's exam pass rate (and live forward results) should dominate the focus.
evidence: focus currently based only on validation survivors
note: Granted 2026-10-21 (prop_search.preferences + exam_evidence): the market focus now reads every market's locked exams (strategies.jsonl entries that sat the exam, any source) and the live forward test of exam-passed strategies (strategy_forward.csv). From 3 exams in total on (even before the 300-strategy mark), a market's exam pass rate (shrunk to the pooled rate with 3 pseudo-exams) enters at full weight while the 2022-23 survivor evidence fades to the power 1/(1 + exams/4); a market with 20+ live forward trades is scaled by 2**clip(t/2,-1,1) (t-stat of its live mean R, up to x2 or /2). 10% floor per market and the halfway-per-run smoothing stay. The focus line in /search shows exams passed/taken and live trades per market.

title: Make the prop simulator harsher where reality is harsher
why: Model what can still sink a funded account: stop slippage on fast/news days (scale slippage with the day's range, extra on red-folder and CL inventory Wednesdays), LucidPro's daily loss limit, and that copy-traded accounts all lose on the same day. A strategy that only works with perfect fills should not pass.
evidence: simulator uses fixed 1-tick slippage, no daily loss limit
note: Granted 2026-10-21. (1) strategy_lab fills (HARSH, default on): stop exits and break (stop) entries pay +1 tick per 50% the session's range exceeds its expected range (max +6), +1 on red-folder days, +2 on FOMC days, +2 for CL on Wednesdays (assumed values, no fill data; STRAT_HARSH=0 reproduces the old fills exactly). (2) The prop sim's worst point per day is now that trade's own stop (or its actual loss if larger), not the median stop: range-stop days reached up to 8x the median, so accounts that really blew used to survive. (3) Daily loss limits: plan fields eval_dll / fund_dll cap a day's contracts so one worst case fits; set for LucidPro 50K eval ($1,200) and Tradeify Select Daily 50K funded ($1,000) from the existing firm research; LucidPro 25K has no documented value yet. (4) An account that cannot trade 1 contract is 'stuck' (dead): the farm frees its slot and buys a new eval instead of keeping zombie accounts; the farm reports the worst single day across all copy-traded accounts (they lose on the same days). Check on 24 sample strategies, 2014-21, LucidPro 50K: avg -0.80 -> -1.03 pts/trade, EV per eval -90.6 -> -95.5, pass rate lower or equal in all 24. New prop-search rows carry sim='harsh-1'.

title: Dynamic position sizing based on consecutive profit days
why: Literature suggests scaling size after streaks improves long‑run EV while preserving drawdown limits; implementing this could turn modest per‑trade edges into higher overall EV.
evidence: Current flat size yields ~+0.03R per trade; scaling could amplify to ~+0.05R on winning streaks.
note: Tested 2026-10-23 by Claude (tools/streak_check.py, research_out/streak_check.json): on F10 v43, seen years 2014-23 (1544 days), days after >=2 profit days averaged -0.042R vs +0.108R otherwise (p=0.75 that streaks help); lag-1 daily-R autocorrelation -0.069 (p=0.006). Streak sizing (+0.5x/day, cap 2x) lowers edge per unit risk +0.091 -> +0.078R/day and raises max DD 92.7R -> 109.4R. Not adopted; no change to prop_sim or the frozen forward test.
